goal: Run the bounded ConstraintBox formal kernel on a proposed task.
deliverable: A deterministic request assessment and precise retry guidance.
in_scope: Assess whether the request is explicit enough to generate an untrusted proposal.
evidence_required: Every required request clause is checked by the fixed request policy.
claim_boundary: This request may authorize proposal generation only; it cannot admit or release a proposal.
unknowns: The assumptions that the requested work is allowed to rely on have not been stated.
communication_needs: Name the exact missing clause and ask a concrete repair question.
